user.title: Link your Ciconia account
user.description: Submit to get a short code. You approve it on the Ciconia website. No password or token to copy.

data_description.base_url: Leave as is. Include https:// at the start.

link_failed.title: Not linked
link_failed.description: Submit to get a new code and try again.

devices.title: Choose trackers
devices.description: Untick any tracker you don't want in Home Assistant. Trackers you add to your account later appear here on their own; change the selection any time under Configure.

data_description.devices: Each ticked tracker becomes a device with a location and sensors.

reauth_confirm.title: Link Ciconia again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer reach your trackers: it was disconnected on the Ciconia website. Submit to get a code and approve it there to reconnect.

reconfigure.title: Change server
reconfigure.description: Moving to another server address means linking again: submit to get a code and approve it with the same Ciconia account.

data_description.base_url: Leave as is. Include https:// at the start.

progress.wait_for_approval:
1. Open **[{url}]({url})** (sign in if asked).
2. Check that it shows the code **{code}** and click **Allow**.

This page continues on its own once you approve. The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.

error.link_denied: The request was denied on the Ciconia website.
error.link_expired: The code expired before it was approved.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Ciconia server. Check the address and your internet connection.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full address starting with https://

abort.already_configured: This Ciconia account is already set up. Its token was refreshed.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Ciconia server.
abort.reauth_successful: Linked again. Your trackers are back.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Moved to the new server address.
abort.wrong_account: That code was approved by a different Ciconia account than the one set up here.

data_description.devices: Unticked trackers are removed from Home Assistant. New trackers on your account are added automatically.
data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant asks for fresh positions. Minimum 5.
data_description.stale_after_seconds: The Stale sensor turns on when a tracker's last fix is older than this.

abort.invalid_auth: Ciconia no longer accepts this connection. Re-authenticate to link again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Ciconia server.

auth_failed.message: Ciconia no longer accepts this connection. Link it again.
